description: Recommended downstream read order for agents consuming the DocLight Design Library.

readOrder.purpose: Agent skill manifest: brand essentials, quick map, component index.
Rich brand narrative: content fundamentals, visual foundations, caveats.
Structured token understanding source for color, type, spacing, radius, shadow.
Runtime CSS variables; link in HTML, do not read for token semantics when css.json exists.
Aggregated component CSS auto-extracted from preview pages.
Component index with cross-component patterns and priority hints.
Article component contract: typography, density, reading lane constraints.
Blockquote component contract: accent border, muted text.
Table component contract: horizontal rules, tabular nums, minimal/card style.
Code block component contract: language label, copy button, mono type.
Navigation component contract: topbar, sidebar, TOC.
Visual reference for code block rendering.

componentResolution: For each component, read preview/component-{slug}.html first for DOM/CSS fidelity; use components/{slug}.json for intent, variants and states; use components/_evidence/{slug}.json only as fallback evidence when preview is missing or insufficient.
